tools.name: search_agents
tools.description: Search the public Agenlify catalog by English or Chinese task, product name or official domain. Filter by pricing, setup, category, task and evidence. Returns dated catalog summaries and source links; empty results mean no documented match.

tools.name: get_agent
tools.description: Get a catalog product by exact slug, including inputs, outputs, setup steps, limitations, human review requirements, pricing review dates, official sources and any separately recorded case studies.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: List Agenlify task IDs, preparation checklists, expected outputs and review requirements. Each listed task has at least three catalog candidates. Optionally filter tasks by category.
